explanation: Three ways a saved change could reach the branch new threads start from. Compare how fast it lands and what checks it. Leaves out where keys are stored, which is a separate question.

columns.title: Push straight to main
items: Machine commits and pushes to main
Fastest; no review; fails if main is protected

columns.title: Pull request (suggested)
items: Machine pushes a branch and opens a pull request

columns.title: Small thread does it
items: A thread starts and its lead edits the file
An agent checks it, then a pull request
